applications.name: Document Management System
applications.summary: Controlled documents with an approval lifecycle, acknowledgement tracking and an AI assistant that answers from document content.
applications.description: A governed document management system. Two repositories — a general one for procedures and Ways of Working, and a deny-by-absence repository for regulated material that never surfaces in search, citations or assistant answers outside its rights matrix. Documents move through draft, review, approval and publication with insert-only version history, per-type retention and review clocks, and read-and-understood acknowledgement assigned by role or by named user. Readers report unclear or outdated content, periodic access-review campaigns capture their own evidence, and governance dashboards cover lifecycle, ownership, review freshness, approval turnaround, acknowledgement completion and assistant analytics.
features: Two document repositories, one of them deny-by-absence for regulated material
Approval before publication, with insert-only version history
Retention and review clocks per document type, with a Legal-Hold override
Read-and-understood acknowledgement by role or named user, with due dates and exemptions
AI assistant over document content, with citations and six defined intents
Reader feedback and periodic access-review campaigns
Three governance dashboards over eighteen visuals
